note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the Mowag Piranha armoured fighting vehicle. The registry marks primary_held false. It publishes the length range, the width range, the height range, the engine, the engine rating, the automatic transmission, the road and water speeds and the range. It publishes no mass and no ground clearance, so those fields are absent.

length_mm.state: length published as a range of 6.25 to 7.45 m; the lower bound of the range recorded, not an average

width_mm.state: width published as a range of 2.5 to 2.66 m; the lower bound of the range recorded, not an average

height_mm.state: height published as a range of 1.8 to 1.98 m; the lower bound of the range recorded, not an average

net_power_kw.state: engine published as 202 kW (275 hp), with no net basis stated

published_power_hp.state: engine published as 275 hp alongside 202 kW, with no net basis

transmission_type.state: transmission published as an Allison MT-653 automatic 6-speed planetary gearbox

max_speed_kmh.state: maximum road speed published as 100 km/h; the water speed is published as 10 km/h
